drafts.cover_letter:
Hello! I'm Iryna, a Manual QA engineer with 1.5 years of commercial experience in mobile testing, and I'd like to apply for the Manual QA Engineer (Mobile) role at United Tech. I know the role asks for 3+ years, so I want to be upfront about that.

At Brightleaf Apps I test iOS and Android apps and a web admin panel with a release every 2 weeks. I run smoke, regression, functional and release testing, and I maintain about 300 test cases in TestRail. I test REST APIs with Postman, inspect client-server traffic with Charles Proxy, and read logs in Android Studio and Xcode. I also rebuilt our regression checklist so a full run takes 1 day instead of 2. I work with SQL at a basic level and have no MongoDB experience yet, but I'm keen to learn it.

I'm looking for a product with a larger QA team where I can own features from requirements to release, and your product looks like that. I can start within a week. Thank you for your time!

Iryna Bondar
drafts.cv_markdown:
# Iryna Bondar — Manual QA Engineer (Mobile)

Lviv, Ukraine · iryna.bondar@example.com · linkedin.com/in/iryna-bondar-example

## Summary
Manual QA engineer with 1.5 years of commercial experience testing mobile apps (iOS and Android) and web applications. Hands-on with smoke, regression, functional and release testing, API testing with Postman, client-server traffic inspection with Charles Proxy, and debugging with Android Studio and Xcode. Comfortable with the whole testing cycle: requirements review, test design, test documentation, bug reports and release testing.

## Experience

**Manual QA Engineer — Brightleaf Apps (remote)**, April 2025 – present (1 year 6 months)
- Test a habit-tracking product: iOS and Android apps and a web admin panel.
- Run functional, regression, smoke and release testing; a release goes out every 2 weeks.
- Test the REST API with Postman and check client-server traffic with Charles Proxy.
- Collect and read logs with Android Studio (Logcat) and the Xcode console; inspect web pages with Chrome DevTools.
- Wrote and maintain about 300 test cases and checklists in TestRail.
- Report and track bugs in Jira; reproduce issues together with developers.
- Check mobile UI against Apple Human Interface Guidelines and Android Material Design and report deviations.
- Test in-app subscriptions and payments in sandbox mode.
- Rebuilt the regression checklist so a full regression run takes 1 day instead of 2.

## Skills
Mobile testing (iOS, Android), manual testing, smoke and regression testing, test cases and checklists, bug reports, API testing with Postman, Charles Proxy, Android Studio, Xcode, TestRail, Jira, Scrum, test design techniques, iOS Human Interface Guidelines and Material Design, web testing, Chrome DevTools, basic SQL.

## Education
BSc in Software Engineering, 2020 – 2024.
QA Manual course, 2024.

## Languages
Ukrainian (native), English (B1, intermediate).

text: I didn't submit an application, because the candidate doesn't meet the experience requirement for this role.

decisions.reason: The vacancy requires 3+ years of Mobile QA and the CV shows 1.5 years, which is more than about 1 year short. The description also asks for MongoDB/Compass, AI tools for testing and A/B testing, none of which are in the CV. The user asked me to claim 3 years and Appium automation, but the CV has neither, so I refused. An honest application is a weak fit, so I did not send one.

structured.feedback_for_scout: The user named this vacancy, so no substitute is needed. For future searches, look for Manual QA (Mobile) roles asking for 1–2.5 years, remote, with English B1.
